people.name: Micah
people.line: A man from Ephraim who set up idolatrous worship.

translations.web: The man Micah had a house of gods, and he made an ephod, and teraphim, and consecrated one of his sons, who became his priest.
translations.bsb: Now this man Micah had a shrine, and he made an ephod and some household idols, and ordained one of his sons as his priest.
